name: cognito
_status: TEMPLATE, UNTESTED: built from AWS documentation, never run against a user pool.
notes: Step-up needs managed login (not the classic hosted UI) and the Essentials or Plus feature plan. On a lower plan the authorize endpoint SILENTLY IGNORES acr_values, so the API check is essential.
The ACR levels are fixed: loa:1 password only, loa:4 password + TOTP. LoA2 maps to loa:4 only (loa:3 would accept password + SMS/email OTP, a weaker policy, so it is NOT accepted here).
The docs say the ACR/AMR feature is rolling out gradually and may not yet be available to a user pool. max_age is supported and compared with auth_time. Refresh preserves acr and auth_time.
acr and amr are in both ID and access tokens per the cited step-up page. Level names can be customised (AcrConfiguration): keep the map in sync.
